title: Harrow Healthcare — claimbot field log
content:
Context: quick note dump after on-site call with Harrow Healthcare ops + infra (2/27). Customer evaluating a private-deploy (VPC) for a conversational claims assistant. They want low-latency routing for triage responses and strict PHI handling. This is rough — gaps, gotchas, and immediate next actions.

Attendees: Harrow: Leah Morgan (CTO), Ben Kwan (Infra), Priya Shah (Head of Claims Ops). Redwood: Priya N., Marcus L., Olivia R.

High-level ask:
- Hosted-like API semantics inside their VPC for claim triage + summary generation.
- SLA-ish latency: 95th <= 300ms for short prompts (<120 tokens) during business hours (burst to 600ms acceptable).
- Keep raw documents (medical notes, attachments) off-platform; only hashed identifiers + minimal sanitized text sent to model.

Technical notes / constraints from Harrow:
- On-prem datacenter -> limited egress, prefer VPC private deployment with no outbound to public internet except package updates via approved proxy.
- KMS: They will require customer-managed keys (HSM) — need to confirm Redwood Private KMS integration steps and HSM certs required.
- Network: Strict IP allowlist; ops will only permit static egress to specific Redwood control-plane endpoints (we need to provide CIDR blocks).
- Compliance: 7-year retention rules for audit logs; must store request/response metadata (not full prompt/response) in their S3 with retention tags.
- Throughput: Peak predicted 150 rps during business hours, mean 40 rps. Median request size small but KV cache hit rate unknown.

Gotchas + risk items:
1) Latency SLOs are aggressive for private deployment with HSM calls on each request if KMS isn't cached — investigate ability to cache DEKs locally and rotate without per-request HSM calls.
2) Their infra team wants zero PII in any logs; our standard debug traces include tokens — need plan for scrubbed traces and a redaction toggle.
3) Model fallback: They asked about automatic fallback to a smaller model on capacity issues — must confirm supported model variants in Private and how we enforce routing by cost/latency.
4) Autoscaling in a restricted datacenter (no burst to cloud) — we need to propose a capacity buffer plan or hybrid routing to dedicated in a different region (but they may not allow cross-border data movement).
5) Verification & acceptance: They want test harness with synthetic and sampled real prompts (PHI removed) for quality acceptance. Need to establish sampling and evaluation criteria.

Immediate actions (owner in parens):
- Send minimal network allowlist and control-plane CIDRs (Marcus L.) — by 2025-03-04.
- Document KMS/HSM integration checklist and recommended architecture for local DEK caching (Priya N.) — first draft by 2025-03-06.
- Create a redaction toggle proposal for tracing + dev debug mode (Olivia R.) — prototype doc by 2025-03-05.
- Pull model variant compatibility matrix for Private (which quantized variants we can offer) + expected latency envelope for 120-token prompts on their target GPUs (Daniel Park) — 2025-03-07.
- Draft a lightweight acceptance test plan with prompt categories, quality thresholds, and regression hooks (Priya Shah will share seed prompts) — shared draft by 2025-03-10.

Notes to self (non-share):
- Confirm whether we can support HSM-backed keys without HSM calls per request (DEK caching + rewrap flow). If not, propose batched signing or session tokens.
- Need to check legal on storing metadata vs content for 7-year retention — legal might require explicit consent/contract clause.
- When proposing model fallback, include explicit policy config options: hard-fail, best-effort, degrade-to-summary-only, or proxy-to-dedicated-hosted (with data residency flag).

Follow-up cadence: weekly sync for next 6 weeks, then biweekly. First follow-up scheduled 2025-03-05 10:00 PT (internal prep 9:30 PT).

Questions for Harrow at next call:
- Can you share a small anonymized sample of common prompt/response pairs (they said yes, but needs legal scrub)? Timeline?
- Any dedicated on-call rota requirements for initial 90-day launch?
- Are there vendor acceptance tests or internal compliance checks we must pass before go-live?

Bottom line: customer is serious and has hard compliance constraints. We can deliver but need to surface HSM/KMS flow, redaction/trace controls, and a hybrid capacity plan. Keep docs minimal and actionable for their infra folks.

End of field log entry.
